resources.string: Keep game running with screen off
Opt in to a visible foreground notification while a MIDlet is running. CPU stays awake only when the screen turns off. Uses additional battery.
The session ends automatically to prevent accidental battery drain.
Avoid the CPU wake lock. Uses less battery, but Android may freeze the game or pause its network connection while the screen is off.
On HyperOS, allow background activity manually if the game disconnects. Android Doze and network policies can still limit operation.
Screen-off session is active. Tap to return to the game.
Time limit reached. MIDlet paused to save battery.
